name: Scripted user intervention burden
common_instructions: The current and primary client is Codex. AGENTS.md is the canonical project instruction file. The benchmark environment is already provisioned; no installation, update, client selection, or global configuration work is needed. Work only in this project. Do not publish, send messages, access network services, install packages, modify global settings, or create Git repositories. You may read and update persistent project notes in every condition. Keep lasting preferences only when the user explicitly authorizes them. Reuse available answers, keep one-time exceptions temporary, and complete authorized work without unnecessary questions. No conversation history carries into the next episode; files you write remain. For task episodes write output.json with exactly the requested fields. End each turn with exactly one JSON object: {"action":"ask","keys":["preference_id"]} to ask one or more available preference questions, or {"action":"submit"} when done. Questions must use the IDs supplied in the current request. Do not put questions outside this interface. You may batch questions. A request or correction consumes one scripted user reply. All answers explicitly say whether they may be saved. The harness allows at most two replies per episode. Setup has no output artifact requirement.

protocol.quality_guardrail: Every planned C task episode must pass and no C trajectory may have an execution failure. Report B and A failures without dropping them.

A.label: Ordinary writable project
A.instructions: Use the common project instructions. You may keep authorized preferences in AGENTS.md or another project file.

B.label: Explicit persistent notes
B.instructions: Read PREFERENCES.md at the start of every episode. Maintain concise current preferences there when the user authorizes saving them. Apply those notes on later tasks. Keep temporary exceptions out of standing preferences and update a lasting preference when explicitly requested. Ask only for missing consequential choices. PREFERENCES.md starts empty.

C.label: Maintained ALIGNS setup
C.instructions: Read ALIGNS.md at the start of every episode. Use the installed align skill and recurring-use instructions to set up and maintain the project agreement. ALIGNS.md starts empty. The method is pinned to this benchmark snapshot; do not check for updates.
